info.title: Administrative Units API - Get Country Subdivisions & Admin Units
info.description: Retrieve administrative units (states, provinces, governorates, districts) for any country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. Each result includes the unit name, admin code, and admin level type. Optionally filter results by one or more administrative levels using the `admin_level` parameter with comma-separated level names; a level name that matches nothing returns a 200 with an empty admin_units array, not an error. A valid country code is required; countries without published admin units return a 404.

get.summary: Retrieve administrative units for a country with optional level filtering
get.description: Returns all administrative units (states, provinces, districts) for a country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Optionally filter by one or more admin levels.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

parameters.name: admin_level
parameters.description: Comma-separated list to filter results by one or more administrative levels (e.g., state, district). A level name that doesn't exist for the country returns a 200 with an empty admin_units array rather than an error.

200.description: Successful response with list of administrative units

400.description: Bad Request — Missing country parameter, or country is not a valid/known ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

InvalidCountryCode.summary: Malformed or unrecognized country code (also returned for well-formed but non-existent codes)

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

404.description: Not Found — Country is a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code but has no published admin units (e.g. Vatican City)

NoAdminUnits.summary: No admin units for this country

value.error: No Admin Unit present in country
value.message: This Country does not have any admin units associated with it.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

AdminUnitsResponse.description: Response containing the administrative units for the requested country, optionally filtered by admin_level.

admin_units.description: An array of administrative unit objects for the specified country.

admin_level.description: Level or type of the administrative unit (e.g., state, district, province).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
